summary: Loesby's 2024 framing of the Gaza war as an elite power struggle identifies the 'Neocon/Zionist faction' and 'pro-Israel elements of the progressive coalition' as a united force crushing those supporting Gazan Palestinians. A 2026 statement questions US political engagement in Israel-related foreign policy. His documented positions condemn the structural forces behind Palestinian harm, placing his language beyond generic humanitarian concern without reaching an explicit genocide designation or a call to sever US military aid to Israel.
